description:
Replays the same amount bought on the first trading day of every month, on one
        portfolio's own daily history with dividends reinvested: what it became against
        what was put in, the day it stood furthest below the money put in so far, and
        the longest stretch below it; then the same plan from every January the record
        allows, because the start year is luck. Use it for 'if I put X a month into
        these, what would it have become?'; for withdrawals living_off_it, for the
        record itself return_history. Holdings are weights here; monthly is the amount,
        start the first year. In the money of each year, before taxes and trading fees.
        What happened, never a forecast or a probability; years before the record are
        not invented.

base.description: Currency every figure is expressed in (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD…). Default USD.
base.title: Base

holdings.description: What is held: {ticker: weight or amount}. Weights need not sum to one; amounts in the base currency are also accepted (then the crises are shown in money). 1 to 100 holdings. Tickers as the exchange lists them (VOO, VWCE.DE, XAW.TO; 'CASH.USD' for cash).
holdings.title: Holdings

monthly.description: Amount bought every month, in the base currency.
monthly.title: Monthly

start.description: The year whose January the plan starts in; the record's first whole January when absent.
start.title: Start

name: monthly_plan

outputSchema.description: The same amount bought every month, replayed on the portfolio's own history (replayed).

_fence.description: What these figures are and are not: descriptive, no forecast, no advice. Repeat its sense when presenting the result.

amount.description: Bought every month, in the base currency.

data.description: Where the prices came from and what was missing or repaired.

as_of.description: Last date of price history used.

missing.description: Tickers with no usable history (left out).

standins.description: Holdings measured through a stand-in with longer history: ticker, proxy, index, from, until, evidence.

limitations.description: What the figures leave out, in words.

record.description: start, end: the shared daily record replayed.

run.description: The plan from `start`: start (first buying day), year, months, put, value, worst_day, worst_value, worst_put, gap (how far below the money put in at its hardest moment), under_months (longest stretch below it, at month ends), brief_dip, under_from, under_to.

start.description: The year whose January the plan started in.

start_years.description: Every January the record allows as a start.

starts.description: The same plan from every January in `start_years`, in order; each as `run`.

title: Money in every month, replayed
